header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received.
body: This petition was filed for alleged encroachment upon the forest land. The compliance report dated 31.05.2022 was filed by Senior Member Board of Revenue Sindh, which reflects that the subject land has now been retrieved. In view of such situation, this petition has become infructuous and is hereby disposed of.
